support.title: Support bundle
support.desc: Send redacted diagnostics to the GateControl server
support.confirmIncludes: Included: app, core and Windows version, tunnel state and last handshake, settings, WireGuard config without keys, network adapters, DNS servers and routes, the last 2000 log lines and recent errors.
support.confirmExcludes: Not included: private keys, preshared keys, API tokens, passwords, setup codes and cookies – they are removed before sending.
support.requestedByAdmin: Your administrator requested a support bundle.
support.failed: Support bundle could not be sent: {{ error }}
support.rateLimited: Too many support bundles – please try again later.
support.tooLarge: The support bundle is too large.
support.forbidden: The server rejected the support bundle (check token/peer).
support.unsupported: The server does not support support bundles yet.
support.notConfigured: Set up a server first – then a support bundle can be sent.

reason.off: Notifications are switched off on this PC.
reason.vpn_only: Push only runs while the VPN is connected.
reason.unsupported: The server does not support notifications yet. Retrying hourly.
reason.push_disabled: Notifications are switched off on the server. Retrying hourly.
reason.direct_not_allowed: The server only allows push through the tunnel. Connects once the VPN is up.
reason.auth: The server refused access. Please set up the server again.
reason.rate_limited: Too many connection attempts. Retrying in 15 minutes.
reason.too_many_streams: The server is busy. Retrying shortly.
reason.insecure_url: Push needs an HTTPS server address.
reason.timeout: Server does not answer. Retrying shortly.

push.tunnelOnly: Push only through the tunnel: outside the tunnel the kill switch only allows HTTPS to the WireGuard endpoint, but the server address points to another host or port.
push.killSwitchOk: With the kill switch on, the push channel uses the same exception as the app itself (HTTPS to the server). Nothing else needs to be allowed.
